name: Holy Aura

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: you and creatures of your choice in the aura

summary: 30-foot Emanation: chosen creatures have Advantage on saves and attacks against them have Disadvantage.
text: Creatures of your choice in the aura have Advantage on all saving throws, and other creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against them. A Fiend or Undead that hits one of them with a melee attack makes a Constitution save or is Blinded until the end of its next turn.
